title: Managing Big Feelings Adventure
welcome_lead: Feelings come in waves — you can surf them. 🌊

final_note: You learned strategies to handle big feelings calmly.

concepts.def: Looking at it a new way
What you say in your head

walkthroughs.body_html:
Big feelings are like waves — they rise, peak and fall.

Step 1: notice it. Name it. 'I'm angry.' Naming alone shrinks the wave. 🌊

Breathing — slow breaths drop heart rate.

Distraction — count things you can see.

Reframing — find another angle ('I'm not failing, I'm learning').

Watch your self-talk — be kind in your head.

Reach for support: family, friends, trusted adults, school counsellor.

Talking shrinks problems. 🤝
